title: Requests
subtitle: Ask the Atlas team for a logo, a custom domain, a theme, a website section or a new feature — and follow every request from here.

logo.label: Logo
logo.description: A professional logo designed for your academy.
logo.cardPitch: Our designers can create a logo that fits your academy's brand.
logo.dialogDescription: Tell us about your brand. The more you share, the closer the first draft will be.
logo.team: Usually handled by the design team.

domain.label: Custom domain
domain.description: Help registering or connecting your own domain.
domain.cardTitle: Want to use your own domain?
domain.cardPitch: We can help you register or connect a custom domain for your website.
domain.dialogDescription: Tell us which address you want and whether you already own it.
domain.team: Usually handled by the infrastructure team.

theme.label: Custom theme
theme.description: A website theme designed around your brand.
theme.cardPitch: Get a theme designed around your brand and the way you teach.
theme.dialogDescription: Describe the look you want. Links to websites you like help a lot.
theme.team: Usually handled by the design team.

custom_section.label: Website section
custom_section.description: A new section for your website that the editor doesn't offer yet.
custom_section.cardTitle: Need a section that isn't here?
custom_section.cardPitch: Describe it and our team will build it for your website.
custom_section.dialogDescription: Describe the section you need and where it should appear.
custom_section.team: Usually handled by the website team.

custom_feature.label: Custom feature
custom_feature.description: Something new in Atlas, built for the way your academy works.
custom_feature.cardPitch: Tell us what you need and our team will scope a custom feature for your academy.
custom_feature.dialogDescription: Explain the problem you want solved and what a good result looks like.
custom_feature.team: Usually handled by the product team.

nextStep.title: What happens next
nextStep.submitted: Your request has reached the Atlas team. We'll review it and reply here — you'll also get an email when anything changes.
nextStep.received: The team has your request and will review it shortly.
nextStep.under_review: The team is reviewing your request and working out the details.
nextStep.in_progress: The team is working on your request. We'll let you know when there's something to see.
nextStep.waiting_for_customer: The team needs your reply. Read their latest message below and answer to keep things moving.
nextStep.completed: This request is complete. If something isn't right, start a new request and mention this reference.
nextStep.rejected: The team declined this request. Their message below explains why.
nextStep.cancelled: You cancelled this request. Start a new one any time.

create.successDescription: We'll reply in your dashboard and by email.

routing.title: Request email routing
routing.subtitle: Choose which team inbox is emailed when a request of each type arrives or the customer replies.
routing.fallback: Leave an inbox empty to email every Platform Owner instead. Requests are never routed to nobody.
routing.invalidEmail: Enter a valid email address, or leave it empty.
routing.emptyMeans: Empty — all Platform Owners are emailed.
